name: vault-skills
description: Landing plugin for the skills, agents and commands exported from Nelson's Obsidian (Johnny Decimal) vault. Ships the static new-skill authoring skill and its bundled conventions; its skills/, agents/, commands/ and hooks/ are populated by the skills satellite of obsidian-mcp-suite (packages/skills, @vault-mcp/skills), which writes them here, and Claude Code loads them in place. The plugin ships no MCP server of its own.
